features.title: Subagent settings
features.summary: The native Subagent plugin page (recursion depth, concurrent count and subagent model selection) from one owned fork of the stock row. Behaviour is the native one; the model catalog read waits for the page's first connected generation instead of being repeated by its first reset, and joins any other page-wide read of the catalog in flight.

onboarding.doneWhen: The recursion depth, concurrency and subagent model show and save.

failureModes: A Host that serves neither subagent namespace hides the page, as natively.
A refused catalog read leaves the model picker in the native error state; the next connection reset reads again.

externalDependencies.boundary: configForms serves the subagent and subagent model-selection sections the page edits.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Focused tests drive the controller with a typed remote and connection fake; the scratch journey uses the real settings shell.

telemetry.reason: Client-only fork: it calls the native session/modelCatalog and settings Remote methods whose Host spans belong to core; the Host half is the native no-op.

verification.testName: reads once at boot: the read waits for the first connected generation, which needs no reread
shares one request with another owner reading the catalog at the same time
